{{Quote|Bolo-ball final. I'm somewhat partisan. Bylluran Athletic.|CT-7567 about his haircut|<ref name="NP" />}}
'''Bylluran Athletic''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Limmie/Legends|bolo-ball]] team that was active during the waning days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="NP" /> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Star Wars Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> Bylluran Athletic made it to a bolo-ball final. [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]] "Rex" was a fan of the team and [[Hair dye/Legends|dyed]] his [[Hair/Legends|hair]] in the team [[Color/Legends|color]] blue during the time of the final.<ref name="NP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bylluran Athletic was first mentioned in the [[2009]] novel ''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]'' written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="NP" />
